endpoints.name: Account Details
endpoints.description: The portal's own details -- portal id, time zone, currency and the account type. One record, and the time zone matters because analytics periods are computed in it.

endpoints.name: Category Analytics Data
endpoints.description: Traffic and conversion analytics broken down by a chosen category -- totals, sessions, sources, geolocation, devices and more. Requires the breakdown and a date range. HUBSPOT'S ANALYTICS IS BREAKDOWN-DRIVEN: the same endpoint returns a different report depending on the breakdown asked for, so the question defines the request.

endpoints.name: Object Type Analytics Data
endpoints.description: Analytics broken down by object type -- event completions, forms, pages, CTAs. Requires the object type and dates.

endpoints.name: Hosted Content Analytics Data
endpoints.description: Analytics for hosted content -- landing pages, site pages, blog posts. Requires the content type and dates.

endpoints.name: Page Analytics Details
endpoints.description: Per-page analytics detail. Requires the content type and dates.

endpoints.name: Blog Analytics details
endpoints.description: Per-blog-post analytics detail. Requires the content type and dates.

endpoints.name: Object Type Analytics Data Exists
endpoints.description: Whether analytics data exists for one object type. A cheap existence check before a full report.

endpoints.name: Events Data
endpoints.description: The behavioural events recorded in the portal. The same endpoint as Events, under a second name.

endpoints.name: Calendar Events
endpoints.description: The content calendar entries -- planned pages, posts and emails, with their dates and states. The publishing plan, as opposed to what was published.

endpoints.name: Calendar Social  Events
endpoints.description: The planned social posts on the content calendar.

endpoints.name: Calendar Task Events
endpoints.description: The tasks on the content calendar.

endpoints.name: Companies
endpoints.description: The companies in the CRM, paged. Same properties model as contacts -- values live in a properties object keyed by internal name, and Company Properties is the decoder. Identified by companyId.

endpoints.name: Recently Modified Companies
endpoints.description: Companies changed most recently. The incremental-sync route.

endpoints.name: Recently Created Companies
endpoints.description: Companies created most recently.

endpoints.name: Company
endpoints.description: One company by id, with its full properties.

endpoints.name: Company Contacts
endpoints.description: The contacts associated with one company. Requires a company id.

endpoints.name: Contacts IDs
endpoints.description: Just the vids of one company's contacts. Requires a company id. Cheaper than the full contact records when only the association matters.

endpoints.name: Company Properties
endpoints.description: Every property a company can carry, standard and custom. The decoder for company data.

endpoints.name: Company Property
endpoints.description: One company property by internal name.

endpoints.name: Company Groups
endpoints.description: The groups company properties are organised into.

endpoints.name: All Contacts
endpoints.description: Every contact in the portal, paged. THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT THING ABOUT HUBSPOT'S CRM DATA: a contact's fields are not columns on the record, they live in a PROPERTIES object keyed by internal property name, each holding a value and a version history. Custom property internal names are generated rather than chosen, so Contact Properties is the only decoder. AND THE LISTING RETURNS ONLY A SMALL DEFAULT SET OF PROPERTIES -- everything else, including most custom fields, must be named in the property parameter or it is simply absent. Contacts are identified by vid, not by email.

endpoints.name: Recently Modified Contacts
endpoints.description: Contacts changed most recently, newest first. The incremental-sync route; the full listing has no date filter.

endpoints.name: Recently Created Contacts
endpoints.description: Contacts created most recently, newest first.

endpoints.name: Contact Profile By ID
endpoints.description: One contact by vid, with the full property set and their form submissions and list memberships.

endpoints.name: Contacts Informations
endpoints.description: Several contacts by vid, in one request. The efficient way to hydrate a known set rather than fetching one at a time.

endpoints.name: Contact (By Email)
endpoints.description: One contact by email address. The lookup when the vid is unknown -- and note an email can be reassigned between contacts, so the vid is the stable identifier.

endpoints.name: Contact Profile
endpoints.description: One contact by their tracking cookie token. The route from an anonymous website visitor to a known contact.

endpoints.name: Contact By User Token
endpoints.description: One contact by tracking token. The same endpoint as Contact Profile under a second name; either will do.

endpoints.name: Contacts By User Token
endpoints.description: Several contacts by tracking token, in one request.

endpoints.name: Search Contacts
endpoints.description: Contacts matching a free-text query across name, email and company. Locates contacts rather than reporting on them.

endpoints.name: Contacts Lifecycle Stage Metrics
endpoints.description: Contact counts by lifecycle stage. THE FUNNEL: HubSpot's lifecycle stage runs subscriber, lead, marketing qualified, sales qualified, opportunity, customer, and this is the pre-computed count at each.

endpoints.name: Contact Statistics
endpoints.description: Portal-wide contact counts -- total, new, and by lifecycle stage. A ready-made summary rather than a scan.

endpoints.name: Contact lists

lookups.endpoint: Recently Added Contacts From A List

endpoints.description: The contact lists in the portal, with name, size and whether each is static or dynamic.

endpoints.name: Contact Lists By Its Unique ID
endpoints.description: One list by id.

endpoints.name: A Group Of Contact Lists

lookups.endpoint: Recently Added Contacts From A List

endpoints.description: Several lists by id, in one request.

endpoints.name: Static Contact Lists
endpoints.description: Only the static lists -- fixed membership, added explicitly.

endpoints.name: Dynamic Contact Lists (Active Lists)
endpoints.description: Only the dynamic lists -- membership defined by filters and re-evaluated continuously. THE DISTINCTION MATTERS: a dynamic list's size changes on its own, so a membership count is a moment in time rather than a stable figure, and its filters state the business's own definition of the segment.

endpoints.name: Contacts In A List
endpoints.description: The contacts in one list. Requires a list id.

endpoints.name: Recently Added Contacts From A List
endpoints.description: The contacts most recently added to one list. Requires a list id. The incremental view of a growing segment.

endpoints.name: Contact Properties
endpoints.description: Every property a contact can carry, standard and custom, with internal name, label, type, field type and options. THE DECODER without which contact data is values against opaque names.

endpoints.name: Contact Property
endpoints.description: One contact property by internal name.

endpoints.name: Contact Property Groups
endpoints.description: The groups contact properties are organised into.

endpoints.name: Contact Property Group Details
endpoints.description: One contact property group by name, with its properties.

endpoints.name: List Blogs
endpoints.description: The blogs configured in the portal -- a portal can run several.

endpoints.name: Blog By ID
endpoints.description: One blog by id, with its settings.

endpoints.name: Blog Previous Versions
endpoints.description: The version history of one blog's settings.

endpoints.name: Blog Previous Version
endpoints.description: One earlier version of a blog's settings.

endpoints.name: Blog Authors (v3)
endpoints.description: The blog authors, with name, bio and social links. The per-writer dimension.

endpoints.name: Search Blog Authors (v3)
endpoints.description: Blog authors matching a query.

endpoints.name: Blog Author By ID (v3)
endpoints.description: One blog author by id.

endpoints.name: List Comments
endpoints.description: The comments on blog posts, with author, content and moderation state. Note unapproved and spam comments share this table, so an engagement count that does not filter includes them.

endpoints.name: Blog Comment By ID
endpoints.description: One comment by id.

endpoints.name: Blog Posts
endpoints.suffix: /content/api/v2/blog-posts?archived={Archived?:true|false}&blog_author_id={Blog Author ID?}&campaign={Campaign GUID?}&content_group_id={Content Group ID?}&&created={Created?:milliseconds }&deleted_at={Deleted At?:milliseconds}&name={Name?}&slug={Slug?}&updated={Updated?:milliseconds}&state={Comment State?:DRAFT|PUBLISHED|SCHEDULED}
endpoints.description: The blog posts, with title, slug, author, publish date, state and content. The content table.

endpoints.name: Blog Post By ID
endpoints.description: One blog post by id.

endpoints.name: Blog Posts Buffer Contents
endpoints.description: The unpublished draft edits of one post. What has been written but not yet published.

endpoints.name: Blog Post Previous Version
endpoints.description: One earlier version of a blog post. The edit history, which the post itself does not carry.

endpoints.name: Blog Topics
endpoints.description: The topics posts are tagged with. The content taxonomy, and the dimension subject-level performance groups by.

endpoints.name: Search Blog Topics
endpoints.description: Topics matching a query.

endpoints.name: Blog Topic By ID
endpoints.description: One topic by id.

endpoints.name: Domains
endpoints.description: The domains connected to the portal, with their type and whether each is primary. Which domain content is served from, and the explanation for a page's public URL.

endpoints.name: Domain By ID
endpoints.description: One domain by id.

endpoints.name: Files Metadata
endpoints.description: The files in the file manager, with name, type, size, folder and URL. Metadata; contents are served from their URLs.

endpoints.name: File Metadata
endpoints.description: One file by id.

endpoints.name: Folder by ID
endpoints.description: One file manager folder by id.

endpoints.name: Tables
endpoints.description: The HubDB tables -- HubSpot's own structured data store for driving dynamic pages. USER-DEFINED SCHEMA: each table's columns are whatever its creator chose, so Table Details must be read before its rows mean anything.

endpoints.name: Table Details
endpoints.description: One HubDB table's schema and settings. Requires a table id. The decoder for its rows.

endpoints.name: Table Draft Details
endpoints.description: The unpublished draft schema of one table. Where a schema change is pending.

endpoints.name: Table Rows
endpoints.description: The rows of one HubDB table. Requires a table id. The data behind dynamic pages, and often where a business keeps reference data HubSpot has no native object for.

endpoints.name: Layouts
endpoints.suffix: /content/api/v2/layouts?category_id={Category ID?}&created={Created?:milliseconds}&deleted_at={Deleted At?:milliseconds}&id={ID?}&label={Label?}&path={Path?}&custom_head={Custom Head Html?}&include_default_custom_css={Include Default Custom Css?}&enable_domain_stylesheet={Enable Domain Stylesheet?}&attached_stylesheets={Attached Stylesheets?}

lookups.endpoint: If Live Layout Has Buffered changes

endpoints.description: The page layouts defined.

endpoints.name: Layout Buffer Contents
endpoints.description: The unpublished edits of one layout.

endpoints.name: Layout Previous Versions
endpoints.description: The version history of one layout.

endpoints.name: Layout Previous Version
endpoints.description: One earlier version of a layout.

endpoints.name: If Live Layout Has Buffered changes
endpoints.description: Whether one layout has unpublished edits.

endpoints.name: Pages
endpoints.description: The website and landing pages, with name, slug, state, publish date and their content. Landing pages are the conversion side of HubSpot's marketing, so their performance links to the forms they carry.

endpoints.name: Page
endpoints.description: One page by id.

endpoints.name: Page Buffer Contents
endpoints.description: The unpublished draft edits of one page.

endpoints.name: Page Previous Versions
endpoints.description: The version history of one page.

endpoints.name: Site Maps
endpoints.description: The sitemaps generated for the portal.

endpoints.name: Site Map
endpoints.description: One sitemap by id.

endpoints.name: Search Your Site
endpoints.suffix: /contentsearch/v2/search?portalId={Portal ID}&term={Search Term}&type={Type?:SITE_PAGE,LANDING_PAGE,BLOG_POST,LISTING_PAGE,KNOWLEDGE_ARTICLE}&domain={Domain?}&language={Language?}&property={Property?:title|description|html|author_full_name|author_handle}&groupId={Group ID?}&tableId={Table ID?}&hubdbQuery={HubDB Query?}&pathPrefix={Path Prefix?}&matchPrefix={Match Prefix?:true|false}
endpoints.description: Searches the portal's published content. The site search readers themselves use.

endpoints.name: Indexed Properties
endpoints.description: The indexed fields of one search document. Requires the document id. What the site search actually matches on.

endpoints.name: Templates
endpoints.description: The page and email templates in the design manager.

endpoints.name: Template
endpoints.description: One template by id, with its source.

endpoints.name: Template Buffer Contents
endpoints.description: The unpublished edits of one template.

endpoints.name: Template Previous Versions
endpoints.description: The version history of one template.

endpoints.name: Template Previous Version
endpoints.description: One earlier version of a template.

endpoints.name: URL Mappings
endpoints.suffix: /url-mappings/v3/url-mappings?id={ID?}&routePrefix={Route Prefix?}&destination={Destination?}&contentGroupId={Content Group ID?}&name={name?}&isOnlyAfterNotFound={Is Only After Not Found?:true|false}&isRegex={Is Regex?:true|false}&isMatchFullUrl={Is Match Full Url?:true|false}&isPattern={Is Pattern?:true|false}&created={Created?:milliseconds }&deleted_at={Deleted at?:milliseconds}&updated={Updated?:milliseconds}&causing={Causing?}
endpoints.description: The URL redirects configured. Where content moved, and the record of what used to live at an address.

endpoints.name: URL Mapping
endpoints.description: One URL mapping by id.

endpoints.name: CRM Object Associations
endpoints.description: The objects associated with one record, by association type. Requires the object id and association type id. HUBSPOT MODELS RELATIONSHIPS AS TYPED ASSOCIATIONS with numeric type ids, so the graph is only traversable through this and the type id decides what the relationship means.

endpoints.name: View Object Type
endpoints.description: The definition of one sales object type. Requires the object type id.

endpoints.name: Object Properties
endpoints.description: Every property of one crm-objects type -- tickets, products, line items. Requires the object type. The decoder for the newer object model, as the per-object property endpoints are for the legacy one.

endpoints.name: Object Property Groups
endpoints.description: The property groups of one crm-objects type.

endpoints.name: Object Type Pipelines
endpoints.description: The pipelines of one object type -- tickets and deals both have them. Requires the object type. Ticket pipelines are the support workflow, so this is what turns a ticket's stage id into a status.

endpoints.name: Deals
endpoints.description: The deals in the CRM, paged. Carries the properties object holding amount, closedate, dealstage, pipeline and any custom fields. DEALSTAGE IS AN INTERNAL ID, not a label, and stages are defined per pipeline -- so Deal Pipelines is required to make a funnel readable, and stages from different pipelines are not comparable.

endpoints.name: Recently Modified Deals
endpoints.description: Deals changed most recently. The incremental-sync route.

endpoints.name: Recently Created Deals
endpoints.description: Deals created most recently.

endpoints.name: Deal
endpoints.description: One deal by id, with its properties and associations.

endpoints.name: Associated Deals
endpoints.description: The deals associated with one contact, company or other object. Requires the object type and id.

endpoints.name: Deal Pipeline
endpoints.description: One deal pipeline by id, with its stages.

endpoints.name: Deal Pipelines
endpoints.description: The deal pipelines, each with its stages, their order and their probability. THE DECODER for dealstage, and most portals run more than one pipeline.

endpoints.name: Deal Properties
endpoints.description: Every property a deal can carry, standard and custom.

endpoints.name: Deal Property
endpoints.description: One deal property by internal name.

endpoints.name: Deal Property Groups
endpoints.description: The groups deal properties are organised into.

endpoints.name: Deal Property Group
endpoints.description: One deal property group by name.

endpoints.name: Ecommerce Settings
endpoints.description: The e-commerce integration settings of the portal.

endpoints.name: Stores
endpoints.description: The e-commerce stores connected to the portal. The bridge to purchase data.

endpoints.name: Store Details
endpoints.description: One store by id, with its sync settings.

endpoints.name: App Sync Errors
endpoints.description: The sync errors for one connected app. Requires the app id. Where a silently broken e-commerce sync shows up.

endpoints.name: Account Sync Errors
endpoints.description: The sync errors across the portal.

endpoints.name: App Account Sync Errors
endpoints.description: The sync errors for apps on this account.

endpoints.name: Object Sync Status
endpoints.description: The sync state of one object type in one store. Requires the store id and object type. Whether purchase data is actually flowing, which an empty result cannot distinguish from no sales.

endpoints.name: Email Subscription Types
endpoints.description: The subscription types recipients can opt into or out of -- newsletters, product updates. Opting out of one is not opting out of all, so this is what distinguishes a lost topic from a lost subscriber.

endpoints.name: View Portal Subscriptions Timeline
endpoints.description: The subscription changes across the portal over time. When people opted in and out, which the current status cannot say.

endpoints.name: Email Subscription Status
endpoints.description: One address's subscription status across every type. Requires the email address. Whether a specific person can still be mailed, and about what.

endpoints.name: Portal Campaign IDs
endpoints.description: The ids of every email campaign in the portal. The index that makes the campaign detail endpoint usable.

endpoints.name: Portal Campaign IDs With Recent Activity
endpoints.description: Only campaigns with recent activity. The narrower, more useful list on a portal with a long history.

endpoints.name: Campaign Data
endpoints.description: One email campaign's aggregate figures by id -- sent, opened, clicked, bounced and the counts behind them. The campaign-level rollup of the event stream.

endpoints.name: Email Events
endpoints.suffix: /email/public/v1/events?appId={HubSpot App ID?}&campaignId={HubSpot Campaign ID?}&recipient={Recipient Email Address?}&eventType={Event type?}&startTimestamp={Start Timestamp?:milliseconds}&endTimestamp={End Timestamp?:milliseconds}&excludeFilteredEvents={Exclude Filtered Events?:true|false}
endpoints.description: The individual email event stream -- every SENT, DELIVERED, OPEN, CLICK, BOUNCE, DROPPED, SPAMREPORT and UNSUBSCRIBE, with the recipient, campaign and timestamp. THE ROW-LEVEL COMPANION to the aggregate statistics, and where a specific recipient's experience is traced. Very large on an active portal, so bound it by campaign or time.

endpoints.name: Email Event
endpoints.description: One email event by its creation timestamp and id.

endpoints.name: Engagement
endpoints.description: One engagement by id, with its associations.

endpoints.name: Engagements
endpoints.description: THE ACTIVITY TABLE -- notes, calls, emails, meetings and tasks are all engagements, distinguished by a type field, each with its own metadata shape and the contacts, companies and deals it is associated with. Paged. Sales activity, meeting counts and call logging all come from here, and the per-type metadata means one parsing rule does not fit all of them.

endpoints.name: Recent Engagements
endpoints.description: Engagements changed most recently. The incremental-sync route.

endpoints.name: Associated Engagements
endpoints.description: The same path as Email Event; the connector carries it under a second name.

endpoints.name: Call Engagement Dispositions
endpoints.description: The call outcome values configured -- connected, left voicemail, no answer. The decoder for a call engagement's disposition, and what turns call volume into call effectiveness.

endpoints.name: Events
endpoints.description: The custom behavioural events defined and recorded. Events are whatever the portal's own tracking sends, so their names and meanings are entirely account-specific.

endpoints.name: Event
endpoints.description: One event definition by id.

endpoints.name: A Group Of Events
endpoints.description: Several events by id, in one request.

endpoints.name: Forms
endpoints.description: The forms in the portal, with name, fields, submission counts and the lists they feed. The acquisition mechanism, and the explanation for where contacts came from.

endpoints.name: Form
endpoints.description: One form by GUID, with its full field definitions.

endpoints.name: Form Submissions
endpoints.description: The submissions of one form, with the values entered and the timestamp. Requires the form id. THE RAW LEAD CAPTURE -- a contact record shows the current value of a field, this shows what was actually typed and when.

endpoints.name: File Uploaded Via Form
endpoints.description: A signed redirect to a file uploaded through a form. Returns a link rather than data.

endpoints.name: Form Fields
endpoints.description: The fields of one form. Requires the form GUID. The decoder for a submission's values, which reference field names.

endpoints.name: Form Single Field
endpoints.description: One field of one form.

endpoints.name: Line Items
endpoints.description: The line items on deals -- the products actually sold and at what price. Paged. A deal carries a single amount; what makes it up is only here, so product-level revenue analysis depends on this table.

endpoints.name: Line Item
endpoints.description: One line item by id.

endpoints.name: Line items Change Log
endpoints.description: The change history of line items since a point.

endpoints.name: Marketing Emails
endpoints.description: The marketing emails in the portal, with name, subject, state, publish date and the lists targeted. The campaign catalogue.

endpoints.name: Marketing Email Revisions
endpoints.description: The version history of one marketing email. Requires the email id.

endpoints.name: Marketing Email Statistics
endpoints.description: The statistics of one email by id. Requires the email id.

endpoints.name: If Email Has Buffered Changes
endpoints.description: Whether one email has unpublished edits. Requires the email id.

endpoints.name: Marketing Emails Statistics
endpoints.description: The same emails WITH their performance -- sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed and the derived rates. THE ONE TO USE for email performance; the plain listing carries no statistics at all.

endpoints.name: Owners
endpoints.description: The HubSpot users records can be assigned to, with name, email and their remote ids. Every CRM record carries an owner id, so this is the dimension per-person performance joins to.

endpoints.name: Owner
endpoints.description: One owner by id.

endpoints.name: Products
endpoints.description: The product catalogue, paged. Part of the crm-objects model.

endpoints.name: Product
endpoints.description: One product by id.

endpoints.name: ProductsChange Log
endpoints.description: The change history of products since a point.

endpoints.name: Publishing Channels
endpoints.description: The social accounts connected for publishing. Whether a channel is connected decides whether broadcast data exists for it.

endpoints.name: Broadcast Messages
endpoints.suffix: /broadcast/v1/broadcasts?status={Filter By Status?:success|waiting|canceled|error_fatal}&since={Filter By Created At?:milliseconds }&channelGuid={Filter By Channel?}
endpoints.description: The social media posts published through HubSpot, with the channel, content, timing and their interaction counts. Social reach, which the content analytics does not cover.

endpoints.name: Broadcast Message
endpoints.description: One social message by GUID.

endpoints.name: Tickets
endpoints.description: The support tickets, paged. Part of HubSpot's newer crm-objects model rather than the legacy per-object APIs, so the shape differs slightly from contacts and deals -- properties still carry the data.

endpoints.name: Ticket
endpoints.description: One ticket by id.

endpoints.name: Tickets Change Log
endpoints.description: The change history of tickets since a point. The incremental-sync feed, and the only record of what a ticket's earlier values were.

endpoints.name: Timeline Event
endpoints.description: One timeline event by id. Requires the application id.

endpoints.name: Timeline Event Types
endpoints.description: The custom timeline event types an application has defined. Requires the application id. Integrations write their own events onto contact timelines, so this is the vocabulary of what a given app records.

endpoints.name: Timeline Event By ID
endpoints.description: One timeline event type by id.

endpoints.name: Timeline Event Type Properties
endpoints.description: The properties of one timeline event type. The decoder for its event data.

endpoints.name: SMTP API Tokens
endpoints.description: The SMTP tokens issued for sending transactional mail through HubSpot. Security inventory.

endpoints.name: Workflows
endpoints.description: The automation workflows, with name, type, enrolment criteria and whether each is enabled. WHERE MOST MARKETING ACTION HAPPENS in a HubSpot portal -- contacts move through these based on behaviour, so a campaign-only view of activity understates it.

endpoints.name: Workflow
endpoints.description: One workflow by id, with its actions and enrolment settings.

endpoints.name: Workflow Performance Statistics
endpoints.description: The performance of one workflow -- enrolments, completions and conversion. Requires a workflow id. Whether the automation is achieving anything, which the definition cannot say.
